format.notes: Dry voice only. No reverb, music or effects; peaks under -3 dBFS; trim silence to ~50 ms. Effects are added in the mix.

archivist.role: M.E.G. archivist (same narrator in every episode)
archivist.voice: Adult, neutral-to-low voice, any gender. Flat, clinical, measured. Must be the SAME voice as earlier episodes.

mara.role: Mara Quist, M.E.G. field researcher, filming Level 94 on a hand-cranked camera she found in the Hub. Curious, warm, wry; her wonder turns to fear after dark.
mara.voice: Woman, late 20s, bright and articulate, a little breathless with delight at first; later whispering, frightened.

animation.role: One of the Animations: a black-and-white 1930s rubber-hose cartoon figure. Cheerful, sing-song, utterly wrong.
animation.voice: High, nasal, chipper 1930s cartoon-character voice (any gender), sing-song cadence, a giggle in it. Original character voice — do NOT imitate any existing cartoon character or actor.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: M.E.G. 档案，第 94 层外勤胶片。拍摄者：外勤研究员玛拉·奎斯特。
lines.en: M.E.G. archive, Level 94 field film. Camera: field researcher Mara Quist.
lines.tts_text: M.E.G.档案，第九十四层外勤胶片。拍摄者，外勤研究员，玛拉·奎斯特。

lines.speaker: mara
lines.subtitle: 「好了，穿过洞口……哇哦。」
lines.en: “Okay, through the hole… whoa.”
lines.tts_text: 好了，穿过洞口……哇哦。
lines.direction: Climbing through, grunting slightly, then genuine delight.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: Level 94，「动画」。生存难度：三级。这里的一切看起来都像是手工捏出来、一帧一帧拍出来的。
lines.en: Level 94, “Motion.” Survival difficulty: 3. Everything here looks handmade, and moves as if it were filmed one frame at a time.
lines.tts_text: Level 94，动画。生存难度，三级。这里的一切，看起来都像是手工捏出来、一帧一帧拍出来的。

lines.speaker: mara
lines.subtitle: 「草是……黏土做的。整座山都是黏土。」
lines.en: “The grass is… clay. The whole hill is clay.”
lines.tts_text: 草是……黏土做的。整座山，都是黏土。
lines.direction: Crouching, pressing it with a finger, laughing in disbelief.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.subtitle: 「山坡中间立着一面墙，旁边摆着沙发和台灯。只有一面墙。」
lines.en: “There's a wall standing in the middle of the hill, with a sofa and a lamp. Just one wall.”
lines.tts_text: 山坡中间立着一面墙，旁边摆着沙发和台灯。只有一面墙。

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 山丘无限延伸，散落着来历不明的汽车、一座水塔，以及只剩一面墙的房间。
lines.en: The hills go on forever, scattered with stray cars, a water tower, and rooms reduced to a single wall.
lines.tts_text: 山丘无限延伸，散落着来历不明的汽车、一座水塔，以及只剩一面墙的房间。

lines.speaker: mara
lines.subtitle: 「天上那个……是一座城堡吗？」
lines.en: “Is that… a castle, up in the sky?”
lines.tts_text: 天上那个……是一座城堡吗？

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 漂浮城堡，立在一座「透明的山」上。城堡里只有守卫，还有动画之王。
lines.en: The floating castle stands on a “transparent mountain.” Inside there are only guards, and the Animated King.
lines.tts_text: 漂浮城堡，立在一座透明的山上。城堡里只有守卫，还有，动画之王。

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 小镇是二十世纪三十年代的样式。中央喷泉里流的是杏仁水，送奶车里装的是杏仁奶。白天，这里没有实体。
lines.en: The town is styled after the 1930s. The central fountain runs with Almond Water; the milk vans carry Almond Milk. By day, there are no entities here.
lines.tts_text: 小镇是二十世纪三十年代的样式。中央喷泉里流的，是杏仁水，送奶车里装的，是杏仁奶。白天，这里没有实体。

lines.speaker: mara
lines.subtitle: 「墙上有指纹。很大的指纹。……是谁捏的这些？」
lines.en: “There are fingerprints on the walls. Big ones. …Who made all this?”
lines.tts_text: 墙上有指纹。很大的指纹。……是谁，捏的这些？
lines.direction: Touching a house; the delight cools into unease on the last question.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 镇上的警报柱会定时播放欢快的卡通音乐。只要音乐还在响，就是安全的。
lines.en: Siren poles in the town play happy cartoon music at intervals. As long as the music plays, you are safe.
lines.tts_text: 镇上的警报柱，会定时播放欢快的卡通音乐。只要音乐还在响，就是安全的。

lines.speaker: mara
lines.subtitle: 「……音乐怎么慢下来了？」
lines.en: “…Why is the music slowing down?”
lines.tts_text: ……音乐怎么慢下来了？

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 入夜后，音乐会彻底停止。然后，「动画」们就出来了。
lines.en: At night the music stops completely. Then the Animations come out.
lines.tts_text: 入夜后，音乐会彻底停止。然后，动画们，就出来了。

lines.speaker: mara
lines.subtitle: 「街那头……有个东西。它是平的。」
lines.en: “At the end of the street… there's something. It's flat.”
lines.tts_text: 街那头……有个东西。它是，平的。
lines.direction: Whisper; the word 'flat' comes out wrong, disbelieving.

lines.speaker: animation
lines.subtitle: 「嘿，朋友！天黑了还在外面晃呀？你看起来……可一点都不像动画哟！」
lines.en: “Hey, pal! Out after dark? You don't look very… animated!”
lines.tts_text: 嘿，朋友！天黑了还在外面晃呀？你看起来……可一点都不像动画哟！
lines.direction: Sing-song, cheerful, with a giggle; the pause before 'animated' is a little too long.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 「动画」只在夜里出现，一旦发现你就会发起猛烈攻击。它们专门攻击看起来不像动画的东西。
lines.en: Animations appear only at night and attack violently once they spot you. They target anything that does not look animated.
lines.tts_text: 动画，只在夜里出现，一旦发现你，就会发起猛烈攻击。它们专门攻击，看起来不像动画的东西。

lines.speaker: mara
lines.subtitle: 「越来越多了……从每扇门里出来……」
lines.en: “There are more… coming out of every door…”
lines.tts_text: 越来越多了……从每扇门里出来……

lines.speaker: animation
lines.subtitle: 「一起来玩嘛——！」
lines.en: “Come and play—!”
lines.tts_text: 一起来玩嘛——！
lines.direction: Gleeful, the last syllable stretched into a shriek of a laugh.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.subtitle: 「门！那扇木门——」
lines.en: “A door! That wooden door—”
lines.tts_text: 门！那扇木门——

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 小镇上有些房子的门通往别的层级：Level 7、Level 9 和 Level 53。
lines.en: Some houses in the town lead elsewhere: to Level 7, Level 9, and Level 53.
lines.tts_text: 小镇上有些房子的门，通往别的层级。Level 7、Level 9，和 Level 53。

lines.speaker: mara
lines.subtitle: 「……下雨了？路灯……这里是……九层？」
lines.en: “…Rain? A streetlight… is this… Level 9?”
lines.tts_text: ……下雨了？路灯……这里是……九层？
lines.direction: Out of breath, disoriented, in the dark; colour has come back to her voice and she doesn't like it.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 奎斯特研究员的胶片在 Level 9 的一座门廊下被找到。胶片的最后一段，不再是定格动画。
lines.en: Researcher Quist's film was found on a porch in Level 9. Its last stretch is no longer stop-motion.
lines.tts_text: 奎斯特研究员的胶片，在 Level 9 的一座门廊下被找到。胶片的最后一段，不再是定格动画。
